title: fix(fields,components): a date typed in a form that the picker cannot read is a field error that refuses submit

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgP6XkfpjCfyzzG2KwQPUZfy)_
Fixes #27483
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：记录表单里手输一个读不懂的日期（如 13/45/2026）时，该字段当场标红并显示提示，点「创建」被拒、对话框不关、不发请求；改对或清空后才能保存。
- 为什么改：原来日期控件不写入读不懂的文本，表单值保持为空（编辑时保持旧值），照常保存并弹成功提示，用户以为日期已存好。
- 风险与回滚：只新增一个可选的控件回调和一条表单校验项，只对 date / datetime 控件生效；回滚即还原本 PR，无数据迁移。
- 先看：`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx`（新校验项 invalidInput 与回调）、`ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/date-picker/DatePickerField.tsx`（上报与撤回）、`ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/types.ts`（新属性的契约说明）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/fields/src/__tests__/date-picker-invalid-text-blocks-submit-27483.test.tsx`，预期 5 条全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The date / datetime picker never writes text that names no date. In a record form that meant the form value stayed what it was (empty on create, the old date on edit), the submit went through and the success toast fired. Per the triage ruling, the unparseable text is now marked invalid through the form's existing field validation, the way a missing required value is.

- **`onInvalidInputChange`** (`@object-ui/fields`, `FieldWidgetComponentProps`): a new optional widget prop. A widget that parses typed text fires it with the message to show when the committed text names no value, and with `null` once the text is valid, cleared, or the widget unmounts. Its doc comment names its producer (the date picker's two faces) and its consumer (the form renderer). It is added to `toHostProps`' `HOST_PLUMBING_KEYS`, so the compile-time partition still holds and `FieldEditWidget` delivers it when a host passes it.
- **`DatePickerField` / `DateTimePickerField`**: report on change only (not on every render), withdraw on unmount, and report nothing while readonly. A widget given the callback leaves the message text to the form's FormMessage, as the `error` slot already does; a host that passes none (the grid's inline editor, the action-param and bulk-action dialogs) keeps the picker's own notice, byte for byte. `aria-invalid` is set either way.
- **`form` renderer** (`@object-ui/components`): a per-field `invalidInputMessages` map (a ref, beside `requiredMessages`, read by the validator at call time) and a first `rules.validate` entry, `invalidInput`, that refuses while a message is held. The callback stores the message and runs `trigger(name)`, so the error shows when the user leaves the field, not only at submit; a withdrawal clears only an `invalidInput` error. `stripRegisteredFieldProps` forwards the callback to the `date` / `datetime` widgets only, so no other widget spreads an unknown handler onto its DOM.
- The `time` widget is a native `input[type=time]` and shares neither the parser nor the commit path, so it is untouched.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/fields/src/__tests__/date-picker-invalid-text-blocks-submit-27483.test.tsx` (new, real `form` renderer plus the production registration of the picker): typing `13/45/2026` and leaving the field shows the form message and `aria-invalid`, with no second notice; pressing Create is refused (the form scrolls to the field) and `onSubmit` is never called; correcting the text clears the error and saves `2026-10-20`; clearing it lets an optional empty date save; a valid typed date saves (control); `datetime` refuses the same way.
- `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/__tests__/form-invalid-input-refuses-submit-27483.test.tsx` (new, probe widget): a report becomes the field message at once and refuses submit; a withdrawal clears it and the submit goes through; only `field:date` receives the callback, `field:lookup` does not.
- `DatePickerField-12622.test.tsx` (updated, the existing "not written, and says so" pin is kept as is): with a host callback the picker reports the message (containing the text and the format), draws no own notice, reports `null` after a valid commit, on clear and on unmount; `datetime` reports too.

## Acceptance notes

- Hosts outside the record form (`FieldEditWidget` for the grid and record-page inline edit, `ActionParamDialog`, `BulkActionDialog`) pass no callback today, so there the picker still shows its own notice and does not block the host's save. Not reproduced here and not filed; noted as the remaining surface of the same channel.
- The message shown is the picker's existing `fields.datePicker.invalid` string ("Not saved: ... is not a date. Type it as FORMAT, or pick one from the calendar."), so no i18n key was added.
- The merge of `main` met the record-currency change in `stripRegisteredFieldProps`; both allow-list lines are kept.
